display.purpose: Wordmark and home hero only — the one place type is allowed to be loud.

title.purpose: Problem-card and modal titles, list item headings.

body.purpose: Problem statements and prose; line-height never below 1.55.

label.purpose: Uppercase filter-rail labels and badge captions.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Gentle lift on a hovered problem card.

shadows.name: accent-hover
shadows.purpose: Tinted lift on home navigation cards (with translateY(-2px)).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Soft ink-blue halo on a focused search field; replaces hard outline.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Problem-preview overlay — deepest shadow, used once at a time.

motion.name: ease-quick
motion.purpose: Color and border-color state changes on buttons, links, inputs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single ink-blue call to action — search submit, primary confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f7cff; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 14px; font: 600 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3d66e0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,124,255,0.25); }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Graphite submit, used for the login form's full-width 'Войти'.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display: block; width: 100%; background: #1a1f2e; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 11px; font: 600 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background: #252c40; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outline action on a card — '👁 Условие', '+ В домашку'.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #fff; color: #666; border: 0.5px solid #e8e8e4; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 11px; font: 400 12px -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #4f7cff; border-color: #4f7cff; }

components.name: Chip / Tag
components.description: Pill-shaped topic tag — ink-blue text on a pale tint; static label, not interactive.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #eef2ff; color: #4f7cff; border-radius: 20px; padding: 2px 9px; font: 500 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; }

components.name: Problem Card
components.description: Flat white content card with a hairline border that lifts on hover.
components.html:
Задача о монополии

Фирма-монополист сталкивается со спросом…
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: #fff; border: 0.5px solid #e8e8e4; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 20px; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.07); border-color: #d0d0ca; } .ds-card-title { font: 600 14px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #1a1a1a; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: #4f7cff; } .ds-card-prev { margin-top: 6px; font: 400 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #666; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: White field with hairline border; focus shifts the border to ink-blue plus a soft halo.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #1a1a1a; border: 0.5px solid #e8e8e4; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; font: 400 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #4f7cff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,124,255,0.15); }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Sticky graphite bar with the ink-blue logo tile and weight-500 links; active link gets a 2px ink-blue underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #1a1f2e; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; } .ds-nav-logo { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 7px; background: #4f7cff; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font: 500 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; margin-right: 16px; } .ds-nav-link { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); text-decoration: none; font: 500 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.12s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link.active { color: #fff; border-bottom-color: #4f7cff; }

narrative.overview: ЭкЗадачи looks like a well-kept graphite notebook owned by a serious economics coach: warm off-white pages, a graphite-dark spine, one disciplined ink-blue pen reserved for the things that matter, and a soft amber pencil that marks difficulty. The interface is calm and dense with information but never loud. It is built for two roles on one platform — teachers see a denser surface, students a lighter one, both sharing the same graphite header and ink-blue accent language. It is infrastructure, not a course: every screen should feel like a precise instrument, not a marketing page.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-paper surfaces, graphite structure, a single ink-blue accent used sparingly.
Flat by default; depth appears only on interaction (hover lift, focus ring, modal).
Math is first-class: KaTeX-rendered formulas, never images, never broken $.
Information-dense but quiet — the accent earns attention because it is rare.
One platform, two densities: teacher-dense, student-light, shared language.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ink Blue (#4f7cff) appears on ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes 'active', 'primary', and 'interactive' instantly legible.

rules.name: The No-Stark-White Rule
rules.body: Pure #ffffff is for content cards only. Page chrome and recessive panels use warm paper (#f7f7f5) or cool paper (#f5f5f3).

rules.name: The Signal-Color Lockbox
rules.body: Amber means difficulty, green means solution-present. Neither is ever borrowed for decoration.

rules.name: The Readable-Math Rule
rules.body: Problem body line-height never drops below 1.55. Inline KaTeX needs vertical air.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Color Hierarchy
rules.body: Heading vs. body is expressed by weight and size, not by tinting text with the accent.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces have a border, never a shadow. Depth is feedback (hover, focus, overlay), not decoration.

dos: Do keep Ink Blue (#4f7cff) under ~10% of any screen — logo, one primary action, active state, links.
Do sit recessive chrome on Warm Paper (#f7f7f5) and content on white.
Do define resting surfaces with a 0.5px Pencil-Line border and reserve shadow for hover/focus/overlay.
Do keep problem-body line-height >= 1.55 so inline KaTeX stays legible.
Do pair every signal color with a shape or word — amber with star, green with check.
Do express hierarchy with weight and size; keep transitions <= 0.15s and degrade under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't build Corporate SaaS surfaces: no gradient hero metrics, no '01 / 02 / 03' scaffolding, no upsell banners.
Don't fall back to a Soviet-textbook / Word look: no Times New Roman, no black-on-stark-white walls of text.
Don't let the public product look like a reskinned Django admin grid.
Don't tint heading text with the accent to 'make it pop' — ink-blue text means link or active state.
Don't borrow amber or green for decoration — they mean difficulty and solution-present.
Don't put a drop-shadow on a resting card, and don't use a border-left color stripe thicker than the hairline.
